notes.title: Wanting Wings is Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2685610/Wanting_Wings/][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017084/6da77ec3f8f4c58f3c61b575ca03579a1711ff2a.jpg[/img][/url]

BaseSon Light’s Wanting Wings: Her and Her Romance is now available on Steam!

Serious, hard-working Hina, lonely and awkward Rin, and the kind and sweet Fumi have been roommates ever since they started school at Seiyou Girls' Academy, an all-girls boarding school. Yet these three girls share a special connection beyond that - they all believe they saw an angel when they were younger, and they've each come to believe that one of the other girls might be an angel as well. Where will these beliefs lead them? Depending on your choices, right into each other's arms! Every pairing between these three girls is possible and it's up to you to determine who winds up falling for who!

This sexy, romantic yuri title is sure to please fans of the genre, so pick up your copy today!

notes.title: OVERDRIVE's Final Title, MUSICUS! is Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1418180/MUSICUS/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017084/e4fbf8bfb27a26152fbace15dcdd5d8dfe70b2e5.jpg[/img][/url]

Growing up, Kei's future could not be any clearer. As the son of a long line of doctors he was on the fast track into medical college until everything changed one day. Forced to drop out and struggle to complete night classes to finish his education, he finds himself doubting the rails that had been laid before him. Did he ever truly want to be a doctor? Could there possibly be any other path for him to take in life? What follows an endeavor taken upon a whim leads to a whirlwind of new experiences and an encounter with rock'n roll that strikes a chord with his very soul. Does he dare to do it? To cast aside his former dreams for the chance to pursue something he never imagined before?

Experience it for yourself in this masterpiece that explores the soul of rock'n roll, and delves into the tribulations that follow every decision we make in life and our careers!

Order this week and get 10% off as well!

notes.title: Celebrate the Holidays With a Tale of Love, Pain, and Complex Human Relationships in Bokuten - Why I Became an Angel!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/668360/Bokuten__Why_I_Became_an_Angel/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017084/01ff93154a2266f3161f859833503664eab9eb02.jpg[/img][/url]

What is happiness?

"Having nothing, means having nothing to lose."

In this cold, cruel world where happiness is finite, and the pursuit is fraught with pain and suffering, what does it really mean to be happy? Love? The absence of pain?

If you were gifted with the ability to revive fading loves, would you choose to do so? Would you let them all play out? Would you try reviving all of them? Or would you pick and choose, deciding which love, which happiness was worth trying to save? What about your own?

Join us for the brand-new challenge from OVERDRIVE featuring a brand-new art style and a story that eschews typical archetypes to deliver a deep, heart-wrenching tale of love and happiness with a realistic bite!

You can also pick up the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1207160/Bokuten_Original_Soundtrack__Vocal_Collection/]OST and vocal albums[/url] from the in-game band, as well as [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/]MangaGamer[/url]'s very first [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1211820/Bokuten__Kick_Start_Generation_OVA__Album/]anime OVA release[/url] - Kick Start Generation - an animated live concert featuring the bands from Bokuten, Kira Kira, and DEARDROPS!

notes.title: Amatarasu Riddle Star Now on Steam!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/768090/Amatarasu_Riddle_Star/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017084/ec0a094b664213d0d2dad212324044517cc27db4.png[/img][/url]
When you wish upon a star, dreams can come true!

As a child, Takaya loved the world and all the possibilities within it, weaving fantastical tales about the world around him, filling it with princesses, robots, rabbits in the moon, and more. Yet as he grew up and learned the truth - that none of those were real - he grew disillusioned with reality and retreated into books. His childhood friend Yua was the only one to stick with him, telling him stories and inviting him to gaze upon the stars with her. Yet once he wishes upon a shooting star, the stars rain down upon his world, transforming it to fantasy. Will Takaya stick with Yua when the chance to live out his fairy tales awaits? Will he try to confront the mystery of the fantasies laid before him?

[url=http://mangagamer.org/riddlestar]http://mangagamer.org/riddlestar[/url]
Find out in this steamy, pure love story available now on Steam!

notes.title: MangaGamer's First Original Title: Koropokkur in Love is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017084/64705465248abfc041fa66f5ae2beb2cd1a0186f.jpg[/img]
After 10 years of localizing and publishing visual novels, we at MangaGamer are now releasing our own original visual novel, [i]Koropokkur in Love ~ A Little Fairy's Tale~[/i], with Hinoue Itaru (Character Designer and Leader Illustrator of Kanon, CLANNAD, Rewrite, etc.) as the lead character designer and illustrator.

Set in modern Akihabara, this heartwarming tale will feature many cute episodes as the heroine helps a young man save his cafe, all while struggling to avoid getting carried away by cats and birds when she accidentally reverts to her normal, miniature size. Will she ever manage to find love? Will she find what she needs to become human? Can she do it before her time runs out?

Find out when [i]Koropokkur in Love[/i] becomes available on September 27th, 2018!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/915560/Koropokkur_in_Love_A_Little_Fairys_Tale/

And if you missed out on the Kickstarter for this title, you can still check out [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1231894392/koropokkur-in-love-a-little-fairys-tale/posts/2269247]our most recent update[/url] to see the awesome Koropokkur merchandise we're developing! More details on how to get your own are available in the post!

notes.title: Let the Space Live Competition Begin!
notes.content:
[h1]Circus's [i]Space Live: Advent of Net Idols[/i], an English-First Japanese Visual Novel designed with the Western Market in mind is now available for the first time![/h1]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/421710/Space_Live__Advent_of_the_Net_Idols/
Different idols representing each of the popular web browsers take the stage in Space Live, a grand idol competition to seize the hearts of NetSpace denizens and expand their holdings! 

With each of the cute idol girls' personality and quirks based on the browser they're parodying, players can enjoy plenty of hilarity as they're pit against each other in many different categories of contests from singing and dancing to acting and swimsuits and even love confessions! Who will win this year's Space Live? Which browser idol will grasp your heart and win your support? 

The competition extends out-of-game too, with voting open now! Who's your favorite browser idol? Who do you think deserves the gold? There's five rounds of face-offs spaced out over the next two weeks, so join in and help your favorite win! 

[url=http://mangagamer.org/spacelive/competition.html]Vote now![/url]

notes.title: ver1.01 Patch
notes.content:
We have fixed the following in this update:
------------------------------------------------------
1. The player's custom name should display in text as intended.
2. Certain conflicts with 3rd party programs preventing the game from launching have been resolved.
3. Certain instances of garbled text, typos, or similar should be resolved.
4. Shortcut keys (F1-F9) are now displayed in correct order in the settings screen.
5. Prompt to enter window mode from full screen is now displayed correctly.
------------------------------------------------------

a. Please uninstall the game from your steam library and reinstall to avoid any version conflict.

b. If you are using the free adult patch, you will need to reapply after reinstallation.

c. Depending on the cloud save file, the "PRODUCT Check error" may pop up. It shouldn't affect gameplay after a restart, but if problem persists please delete your save files.
